text: For the postmortem: what time did I first report the kiosks offline on 3 Aug, and what was the guard doing in the meantime?
reply_text:
I replied to Gideon in the thread in #inc-vtg-hartford.

- **First report:** 10:42 AM on 3 Aug, in that channel. He said both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan.
- **The guard:** he was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. Gideon's 10:42 post says so, and nothing later in the channel contradicts it.
- **Recovery:** Mateo said kiosk 1 was back at 11:03, when the guard checked in trailer 8836. Gideon posted at 11:08 that both lanes had been working since 11:07. That makes roughly 21 to 25 minutes on the clipboard, depending on which of those you count to.

I also told him the channel doesn't say what the guard did between 10:42 and 11:03 beyond the clipboard, or when kiosk 2 recovered. I added a note that the times are in workspace time (UTC-5), which I assumed from the clock offset.
